decisions.rationale: Only direction that differentiates from n8n/Make/Zapier
Serves both non-technical and technical users; node-level progressive avoids upfront decision anxiety

decisions.decision: Data processing: Data Mapper (visual) + AI Processor (LLM) replace Code node in simple mode
decisions.rationale: Simple things should be fast (mapper), complex things should be easy (AI); tested that LLM can replace Code for data extraction

decisions.decision: Webhook trigger instead of built-in cron
decisions.rationale: Two birds one stone; external cron services can call webhook; no scheduler needed

decisions.decision: HTTP node: keep generic + add test button
decisions.rationale: API templates are premature; test button solves the biggest pain point with minimal code

decisions.decision: nodeOutputs = single source of truth, variables = derived view
decisions.rationale: Autoplan eng review found dual storage creates divergence bugs

decisions.decision: Condition V1/V2 dual executor strategy (not auto-migration)
decisions.rationale: Autoplan eng review found v1 expression cannot be deterministically migrated to v2 format; v1 expressions reference flat variables map, not node-scoped outputs

decisions.decision: AI-generated workflows must never contain code nodes (server-side enforcement)
decisions.rationale: Autoplan eng review flagged RCE risk: AI gen + code executor = arbitrary JS execution on server

decisions.decision: Webhook route exempt from API_AUTH_KEY, mandatory webhook secret
decisions.rationale: External services (GitHub, Slack) cannot send x-api-key header; webhook path alone is not sufficient security

decisions.decision: Per-execution EventEmitter instead of global singleton
decisions.rationale: Autoplan eng review found listener leak under concurrent load

decisions.decision: DB upsert: change tokens? to tokens !== undefined
decisions.rationale: tokens=0 is falsy, causing non-LLM executors to skip tokens update
